subject: Renewal paperwork: finish-line sequencing for uplift and MSA cleanup
messages:
From: Samantha Reiss <samantha@gridworks.io>
To: olga_petrov <olga@redwood.ai>
Cc: Luke Chen <luke.chen@gridworks.io>, GridWorks Procurement <procurement@gridworks.io>
Date: Sat, 18 Dec 2027 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal kickoff: Q1 capacity uplift + MSA cleanup

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the helpful call earlier. As discussed, GridWorks is ready to move forward on a 20% capacity uplift for Q1 (target go-live 2028-01-15) and we want to fold the coverage clarifications into the renewal paperwork rather than a separate SOW.

Two asks from our side that will impact legal:
- Move Exhibit C (coverage schedule) to a consolidated Exhibit C and remove the legacy Exhibit F carve-outs.
- Shorten the auto-renew notice from 90 days to 60 days and add explicit credit remedies for unplanned downtime over the SLA.

I've attached the procurement summary and a draft procurement timing sheet. Can your team take the lead on sequencing the MSA + orderform + consolidated Exhibit C so we can hit the Jan 15 target? Procurement will need a DocuSign-ready packet by 2027-12-22.

Att: GridWorks_Procurement_Summary.xlsx

Best,
Samantha
Samantha Reiss
Head of Procurement, GridWorks

From: olga_petrov <olga@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Reiss <samantha@gridworks.io>
Cc: ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 18 Dec 2027 16:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: Q1 capacity uplift + MSA cleanup

Samantha —

Appreciate the clear asks and the timing. We'll own the sequencing and legal handoff. Quick plan from our side:
1) Redwood legal to produce an annotated MSA with the 60-day notice and SLA remedy language (target 12/20).
2) Order form for the uplift (20% capacity) will be produced by Sales Ops and bundled with Exhibit C (consolidated coverage).
3) We will circulate a single DocuSign-ready packet for procurement review on 12/21 to meet your 12/22 procurement window.

Ben — can you take point on legal redlines? Marcus / Marissa — please build the draft orderform and a short change log that procurement can attach to the DocuSign packet.

Samantha — can you confirm the primary signer and whether GridWorks legal prefers redlines in Word or PDF? We typically send both but will prioritize their preference.

Thanks,
Olga
Olga Petrov
Manager, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
olga@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0148

From: ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: olga_petrov <olga@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 19 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Renewal kickoff: Q1 capacity uplift + MSA cleanup

Olga / team —

Taking point on legal redlines. I'm attaching our initial annotated MSA with proposed language for: 60-day renewal notice, SLA credit table for extended incidents, and Exhibit C consolidation notes. High level notes:
- SLA credits: suggest caps that align with existing precedent (monthly credit capped at 25% of monthly fees).
- Auto-renew notice: change to 60 days, but include a carve for pricing re-quote if capacity increases >15%.
- Exhibit C: we will collapse legacy carve-outs into a single coverage table and flag any insurer/indemnity implications for legal ops.

Attachment: Redwood_Redlines_GW_v1.docx (tracked changes).

Quote from Samantha's note below for context:
> Two asks from our side that will impact legal:
> - Move Exhibit C (coverage schedule) to a consolidated Exhibit C and remove the legacy Exhibit F carve-outs.
> - Shorten the auto-renew notice from 90 days to 60 days and add explicit credit remedies for unplanned downtime over the SLA.

I'll aim to have a Word redline ready by EOD 12/20. If procurement wants a PDF redline first, let me know and I'll export.

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Samantha Reiss <samantha@gridworks.io>
To: olga_petrov <olga@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: Luke Chen <luke.chen@gridworks.io>, GridWorks Procurement <procurement@gridworks.io>
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2027 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: Q1 capacity uplift + MSA cleanup

Thanks Ben — Word redline is preferred. Our legal lead (Luke Chen) will be the primary signer for the MSA; procurement will sign the order form.

We've attached our own redline (GW_Renewal_Redline_v3.docx) with a few requested edits to the SLA language (section 5.2) and an updated Exhibit C (GridWorks_SOW_2028_ExhibitC.pdf) showing the coverage matrix we want reflected.

DocuSign note: procurement needs a consolidated packet (MSA + order form + Exhibit C) in DocuSign by 2027-12-22 COB for our internal approval meeting 12/23. Here's our signing link to use once you upload the packet: https://www.docusign.com/embeddedSigning?envelopeId=0f1a2b3c

Atts: GW_Renewal_Redline_v3.docx; GridWorks_SOW_2028_ExhibitC.pdf

On a separate note — GridWorks asked whether the uplift billing will be prorated from 2028-01-15 or billed from 2028-02-01. Procurement prefers prorated to the start date.

Samantha

From: olga_petrov <olga@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Reiss <samantha@gridworks.io>, Luke Chen <luke.chen@gridworks.io>
Cc: ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Dec 2027 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: Q1 capacity uplift + MSA cleanup

Samantha / Luke —

Thanks for the redline and clarity on signer roles. Quick status and asks from Redwood:
- Ben uploaded the Word redline (Redlines_Redwood_OlgaNotes.pdf attached to our packet) this morning and legal completed a companion clean MSA for DocuSign.
- Marcus & Marissa prepared the order form with the 20% uplift and included a prorated billing schedule starting 2028-01-15; we've added a one-page change log for procurement.
- We'll bundle: clean MSA (with signatures flow set to Luke -> Olivia (procurement) -> Redwood sales ops), order form, consolidated Exhibit C, and the change log.

Next steps we need from GridWorks to finalize the packet by COB 12/22:
1) Quick confirmation that Luke will sign first (you indicated yes).
2) Procurement to confirm the email for the primary procurement signer (we have procurement@gridworks.io but flagging incase you want a specific person).
3) Confirm you accept our proposed credit cap (monthly credit cap at 25%) or flag if Luke/legal want different credit ceilings.

If we get confirmations today we'll upload to DocuSign and route for signature. If anything needs a last-minute redline change, please flag in-line in Word with tracked changes so we can evaluate quickly.

Thanks — happy holidays in advance. If we get everything done this week we’ll lock Jan 15 as the go-live and send a short rollout checklist to your cloudops contact.

Olga
Olga Petrov
Manager, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
olga@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0148

Attachments referenced: consolidated_packet.zip (contains clean_MSA_for_ds.docx, orderform_Q1_uplift.pdf, GridWorks_SOW_2028_ExhibitC.pdf, Redlines_Redwood_OlgaNotes.pdf)
